description: pkix-path/src/lib.rs:1280: names_match uses bidirectional AVA matching (forward AND reverse pass). The comment explains why: for a malformed RDN {CN=Alice, CN=Alice} vs {CN=Bob, CN=Alice}, the forward pass matches both, but the reverse pass finds no match for CN=Bob, correctly returning false. A unidirectional check would return true incorrectly. A contributor might simplify to one-directional; that is wrong for the duplicate-OID case.
title: Bijective AVA matching in names_match handles malformed duplicate-OID RDNs correctly
